records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As a result, net sales revenue decreased 27% in the three months ended June 30, 2023, to $10,005, compared to $13,725 in the same period last year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Core brand gross billing decreased by 26% to $11,095 compared to $14,972 during the same period last year, driven by a Reed’s volume decline of 13% and Virgil’s volume decline of 44%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease was a result of volume declines that have impacted the CSD segment as a result of price increases coupled with the Company’s inability to produce sufficient levels of inventory to meet current demand as a result of tighter credit terms from suppliers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the period ended June 30, 2023, the Company continued to strengthen its supply chain, implement gross margin enhancement initiatives, drive efficiencies in transportation and warehouse costs and reduce operating expenses.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The sales growth focus is on channel expansion, increase in store placements, new product introduction and improved sales execution.
